summary: Defines how an SNMP notification (a trap or inform message) is translated into a syslog message. This lets a device that speaks SNMP have its events show up in ordinary syslog collectors in a predictable format. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: One machine shouts alerts in one language and another writes them in a diary in a different language. This document is the translation guide, so an alert from the first can be written down properly in the second.

questions: how to convert snmp traps to syslog
